# Folder Data

Folder ini digunakan untuk menyimpan dataset hasil scraping dan cleaning.

## 📁 Files

### 1. `periplus_books_raw.csv`
Dataset mentah hasil scraping langsung dari Periplus.com.

**Source:** Generated by `scrapers/scrape_periplus.py`

**Columns (16):**
| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| title | string | Judul buku |
| author | string | Nama penulis |
| binding | string | Jenis cover (Paperback/Hardcover) |
| in_stock | int | Ketersediaan (1=ada, 0=habis) |
| category | string | Kategori buku |
| product_url | string | URL produk |
| price_idr | float | Harga saat ini (IDR) |
| original_price_idr | float | Harga asli (IDR) |
| discount_percent | float | Persentase diskon (0-100) |
| isbn | string | ISBN-13 number |
| publisher | string | Nama penerbit |
| publication_date | string | Tanggal terbit (format varies) |
| pages | int | Jumlah halaman |
| language | string | Bahasa buku |
| weight | float | Berat buku (kg) |
| review_count | int | Jumlah customer reviews |

**Expected size:** ~1500 rows

---

### 2. `periplus_books_clean.csv`
Dataset bersih yang siap untuk analisis.

**Source:** Generated by `scrapers/clean_data.py`

**Additional columns (7 new features):**
| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| publication_year | int | Tahun terbit (extracted from publication_date) |
| book_age | int | Umur buku dalam tahun (2026 - publication_year) |
| price_per_page | float | Harga per halaman (price_idr / pages) |
| popularity_score | float | Skor popularitas (review_count × discount_bonus) |
| is_new_release | int | Flag buku baru: 1 jika >= 2024, 0 otherwise |
| price_category | string | Budget / Mid-range / Premium / Luxury |
| has_discount | int | Flag diskon: 1 jika ada, 0 jika tidak |

**Total columns:** 23  
**Expected size:** ~1500 rows (after removing duplicates & invalid data)

---

### 3. `data_summary.txt`
File text berisi summary statistics dari dataset clean.

**Content:**
- Descriptive statistics (mean, median, std, min, max, dll)
- Missing values summary
- Data types info

---

## 📊 Data Quality Expectations

### Completeness:
- **title, author, category, price:** 100% complete (required)
- **isbn, publisher:** ~90-95% complete
- **pages, weight:** ~70-80% complete (not all products have this info)
- **publication_date:** ~85-90% complete
- **review_count:** 100% complete (0 if no reviews)

### Missing Value Handling:
- **Categorical fields:** Filled dengan "Unknown" atau "Unknown Publisher"
- **Numeric fields:** Kept as NaN untuk analisis yang tepat
- **review_count:** Filled dengan 0

### Data Validation:
- ✅ No duplicate books (by title, author, ISBN)
- ✅ All prices > 0
- ✅ discount_percent range: 0-100
- ✅ in_stock: 0 or 1

---

## 🔍 Usage Examples

### Load raw data:
```python
import pandas as pd
df_raw = pd.read_csv('data/periplus_books_raw.csv')
print(df_raw.info())
```

### Load clean data:
```python
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data/periplus_books_clean.csv')
print(df.head())
```

### Explore data:
```python
# Distribution by category
print(df['category'].value_counts())

# Price statistics
print(df['price_idr'].describe())

# Books with discount
print(f"Discounted books: {df['has_discount'].sum()}")
```

---

## 📝 Notes

- File CSV ini di-generate otomatis oleh script scraper & cleaner
- Jangan edit manual untuk menjaga konsistensi data
- Untuk re-scraping, hapus file `periplus_books_raw.csv` dan jalankan ulang scraper
- Dataset di-update berdasarkan data website saat scraping dijalankan
